known_security_notice.availability: Not verified on GitHub-hosted runners; no Pro activation authorized

decision: Keep reproducible CI pinned for now and expose the known security gap. A new baseline requires reviewing Ubuntu USNs, verifying repo/license eligibility without spending or enabling Pro, updating all workflow pins and FFmpeg_BINARY, then rerunning 3 ephemeral smoke tests before any merge.

open_cve_evidence.impact: crafted MP4 MOV/PSSH input may cause stack exhaustion and denial of service
open_cve_evidence.scope: This CVE is separate from USN-8915-1. No untrusted MP4 input is authorized and no candidate baseline is declared fixed.

upstream.change: av_encryption_init_info_free iterative loop replaces recursive free; addresses stack exhaustion, no claim on all CVE impacts
upstream.gate: Require signed/reviewed distro package changelog fixing this CVE, package eligibility, sandbox, and separate CI validation before changing baseline

remediation_gate: Upstream iterative-free commit on master is not equivalent to a released/backported fix. Debian Trixie package still tracked vulnerable; Ubuntu noble/resolute need evaluation. Confirm official patched distribution package/version plus trust and CI before changing any FFmpeg baseline; no Ubuntu Pro activation or untrusted media.
